premises.text: There is an urgent need for rapid decentralized diagnostics because patients wait months and outbreaks spread without knowing who is infected
premises.evidence_span: There is an urgent and growing need for rapid decentralized diagnostics

premises.text: Current portable dipsticks lack early-detection sensitivity and PCR is too costly and non-portable for near-patient use
premises.evidence_span: it's not sensitive enough to detect early case detection. And the PCR, although it's very sensitive, it is very costly

premises.text: FastChip is an affordable field-ready vacuum microfluidic kit with isothermal amplification, quantitative fluorescence readout via smartphone optics, and no external pumps
premises.evidence_span: M's Fluidics solution is the FastChip, a field-ready, affordable, sensitive, and trackable solution

premises.text: At-scale manufacturing will make the chip and reader orders of magnitude lower cost than PCR
premises.evidence_span: At scale manufacturing, the chip and the reader will be orders of magnitude lower cost than PCR solutions

premises.text: App-based GPS/patient/results tracking creates a disease network for ministry resource deployment, with research-tool then FDA diagnostic GTM
premises.evidence_span: We're building a trackable platform, an app that tracks GPS data, patient info, and test results

value.text: Rapid field molecular diagnostics that return results within one hour
value.evidence_span: Results come out within one hour, so patients don't have to wait for days to get the results

causal_links.evidence_span: urgent and growing need for rapid decentralized diagnostics
field-ready, affordable, sensitive, and trackable solution

notes: Singleton D3 retained: tracking/FDA path is a separately learnable GTM module. Cost-at-scale kept with product because speaker ties affordability to vacuum format. Future multi-disease screening folded into FastChip (v1.3.2 #5).
